article.headline: Witherspoon’s 20 help George Washington knock off UMBC 91-51
article.description: — Omari Witherspoon had 20 points in George Washington’s 91-51 win against UMBC on Friday.
article.linkText: Witherspoon’s 20 help George Washington knock off UMBC 91-51
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Omari Witherspoon had 20 points in George Washington’s 91-51 win against UMBC on Friday. Witherspoon also had nine rebounds and five assists for the Revolutionaries (6-2). Felix Kossaras scored 15 points and added three steals. Ryder Frost went 5 of 13 from the field (4 for 12 from 3-point range) to finish with 14 points. Aidan Able led the way for the Retrievers (4-6) with eight points. Evan Morton added eight points for UMBC. Aasim Burton also had seven points, four assists and two steals. George Washington led 47-23 at halftime, with Witherspoon racking up 18 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
